decisions.reason: Launched only in 2018 and given its own webpage, the product reflects visible recent investment that management is likely to continue backing rather than abandon after such a short market period.

Although it was only mentioned on the website, it is still a very recent launch and management in a medium-sized machinery firm would likely attribute any weak early uptake to start-up conditions and keep it for now.
As a 2018 launch with at least some public market presence, it is still too early for management to reverse course and they are likely to persist despite limited initial visibility.
Its own product page signals a stronger public commitment, making management more likely to justify prior development effort and retain it on the market.
Because the firm has already given this 2018 product a dedicated presentation, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within the next year relatively unlikely.
Even with weaker website prominence, the product is still newly introduced and management is likely to continue supporting it rather than accept an early visible retreat.
